user_query: I'm planning a family vacation to Paris next month. Can you provide me with a list of available voices for text-to-speech conversion? Also, suggest some popular tourist attractions in Paris and their audio descriptions. Additionally, predict the weather forecast for the dates of my visit using the timeseries prediction model.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of available voices for text-to-speech conversion.
Suggest popular tourist attractions in Paris.
Get audio descriptions for the suggested tourist attractions in Paris.
Predict the weather forecast for the dates of the user's visit to Paris using a timeseries prediction model.
